text.arabic_uthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ خَٰشِعَةًۭ فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening a fresh earth-sign scene within the continuing sign discourse
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as resumption, so the revived-earth proof is heard as another member of the continuing sign discourse rather than a detached weather scene. It also bridges the unwearied worship of 41:38 into terrestrial evidence, changing the register while preserving continuity.

topics.headline: resumptive sign opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth-rain scene begins as cumulative evidence within a continuing sequence of signs.
topics.reason: The conjunction stands at the ayah opening and the boundary rows tie 41:39 to the preceding worship scene.

words.gloss_range: partitive and source-marking preposition that classifies the whole observation before the scene unfolds
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) governs the sign noun and classifies the whole seeing clause as one item from a larger evidentiary field. Because it is fronted, the listener receives the interpretive category before earth, rain, motion, and revival appear: this is evidence, not a neutral nature report.

topics.headline: fronted evidence frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phenomenon is classified as one divine sign before it is narrated.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the preposition govern the possessed plural sign noun at the front of the clause.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural signs; readable evidence field that frames the whole ayah
words.root_gloss_range: sign, mark, proof, and recited unit; a disputed return-coloring remains secondary to the local sign/proof sense
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ}} ({{tr:āyātihī}}) makes the scene plural and possessed: the revived earth is one readable sign belonging to Him, not autonomous spectacle. The plural expands a single observed process into an evidentiary class, and the phrase governs the later seeing, rain, motion, life-giving, and power claim as one chain. Its local sign field anticipates the broader display of signs in 41:53, while the disputed return-coloring is useful only as a secondary inference pressure.

topics.headline: owned plural signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one earth scene is made a readable, possessed member of a wider evidence field.
topics.reason: The noun is feminine plural genitive with a third-person suffix and is governed by the preceding preposition.

topics.headline: whole-ayah sign chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks sight, rain, motion, revival, and capacity as stages inside one sign argument, with 41:53 widening the same sign-display arc.
topics.reason: The fronted sign phrase is completed by the following content clause and the inter-ayah rows give concrete links to 41:53.

topics.headline: return coloring held secondary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a return-from-phenomenon-to-agent pressure, while the local noun remains a sign/proof term.
topics.reason: The root dispute is meaningful, but local grammar and the sign-frame keep sign/proof as the selected sense.

words.gloss_range: assertive content particle with second-person suffix, making the addressee’s seeing the sign-content
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّكَ}} ({{tr:annaka}}) turns the following perception clause into the content of the sign. The attached second-person suffix places the addressee inside the proof before the resurrection conclusion is stated, so the ayah moves from reported reality into participatory observation.

topics.headline: witnessed sign content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is routed through the addressed observer’s own seeing, not presented as distant report.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the content clause after the sign phrase and carries a second-person masculine suffix.

words.gloss_range: imperfect second-person seeing that stages repeatable perception before inference
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, and judging; local syntax selects perception that must become inference
words.prose: {{ar:تَرَى}} ({{tr:tarā}}) is imperfect second-person perception, making the proof repeatable whenever the scene recurs rather than a one-time report. The seeing root also pressures judgment: the observer must move from visible earth-state to reasoned resurrection inference. This witness-before-assertion structure echoes the sign-looking pattern of 30:50 and anticipates the wider showing of signs in 41:53.

topics.headline: repeatable addressed seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proof is staged through recurring personal witness before doctrinal assertion.
topics.reason: QAC parses the verb as imperfect 2MS taking the earth as object and preceding the inference clause.

topics.headline: sight becomes inference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that visual perception is meant to become judgment, while local syntax still begins with seeing the earth.
topics.reason: The root range includes assessment, but the local verb directly governs the visible earth and its state.

words.gloss_range: definite earth as seen object, state-bearer, recipient, responder, and analogy base
words.root_gloss_range: soil, land, territory, and earth-domain; local scene starts concrete and carries wider created-order inference
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضَ}} ({{tr:al-arḍa}}) is the definite object of seeing and the bearer of the humbled state, so the proof begins with a familiar visible domain. Across the ayah the same earth receives water, responds with motion and swelling, and is later named as revived; its roles shift from patient to respondent to analogy base. The soil-level event can therefore carry the larger created-order argument, as in the earth-revival logic of 30:19.

topics.headline: earth carries changing roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows one familiar earth through object, state-bearer, recipient, responder, and revived object rather than treating the scene as separate images.
topics.reason: The definite accusative noun is object of seeing and its feminine referent is resumed by later suffixes and verbs.

topics.headline: visible analogy base
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the visible land become the base for resurrection inference, while the local sense remains concrete earth before it widens.
topics.reason: The root range can widen to land/world, but local grammar first selects the concrete seen earth that supports the later analogy.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial active-participle state of humbled low stillness, prepared for reversal
words.root_gloss_range: humility, loweredness, stillness, and submissive posture; locally transferred to the earth as visible barrenness
words.prose: {{ar:خَٰشِعَةًۭ}} ({{tr:khāshiʿatan}}) is a circumstantial state, not the earth’s permanent identity. The human posture word is transferred to land, so barrenness is pictured as lowered stillness before animation. Its participial stillness lets the following motion and swelling feel like reversal, and the lowered-eyes echo at 79:9 sharpens the image without making the earth human in a literal sense.

topics.headline: temporary lowered state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth is caught in a reversible state of low stillness before the motion verbs interrupt it.
topics.reason: The form is a feminine accusative active participle functioning as a circumstantial state of the earth.

topics.headline: human posture transferred
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels barrenness as humbled low posture, while local grammar keeps it a metaphorical state of the earth.
topics.reason: The root often describes humbled persons or eyes, but here feminine agreement ties the participle to the earth.

words.gloss_range: sequencing/result connector pivoting from seen state into the rain-trigger clause
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks the turn from the earth’s seen stillness into the condition that changes it. The split proclitic lets sequence and consequence be heard before the temporal particle, so the ayah pivots from state to trigger rather than merely adding another clause.

topics.headline: pivot into trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition from humbled state into the rain event as consequential sequence.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as a result/sequence connector prefixed to the temporal particle.

words.gloss_range: temporal-conditional particle making rain descent the recurring trigger for the result
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَآ}} ({{tr:idhā}}) frames the descent of water as a temporal condition. The scene is vivid but repeatable: when the water is sent down, the earth-response follows. That conditional-time frame turns an observable natural recurrence into an argument.

topics.headline: recurring trigger frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rain scene is not isolated scenery but a repeatable condition that yields proof.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the temporal protasis whose result is the paired earth-response verbs.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural causative sending-down of water; controlled descent before natural response
words.root_gloss_range: descending, sending down, lodging, and disclosure; local Form IV selects caused descent of water with possible revelation-coloring only secondary
words.prose: {{ar:أَنزَلْنَا}} ({{tr:anzalnā}}) is a first-person plural causative: the water does not simply fall but is sent down under divine agency. Its perfect form after the temporal particle gives the recurring condition vivid completed force. The descent field can color provision and disclosure, but local grammar selects the caused descent of water onto earth; that same root answers earlier descent language in 41:14 by turning challenge into life-giving proof.

topics.headline: controlled water descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the natural response begins from divinely caused descent, not from autonomous rain.
topics.reason: QAC parses the verb as a causative perfect with water as direct object and the earth phrase as target.

topics.headline: descent field colored by provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears water-descent as part of a broader descent/provision pattern, while the local object keeps rain as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The local direct object is water, so broader disclosure/descent branches may color the scene but do not replace rain descent.

words.gloss_range: preposition-plus-feminine suffix marking the earth as targeted recipient surface
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهَا}} ({{tr:ʿalayhā}}) keeps the same feminine earth in view and marks the water’s directed contact with it. Because the recipient phrase comes before the water object, the ayah keeps attention on the surface that will be activated, rather than letting rain alone carry the sign.

topics.headline: same earth targeted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the water is aimed at the same earth already seen humbled, preserving the analogy’s referent.
topics.reason: The preposition carries a 3FS suffix referring to the earth and precedes the water object in the descent clause.

words.gloss_range: definite concrete water as direct object and activation medium between humility and life
words.root_gloss_range: water/substance field with disputed root-family pressure; local sense is concrete water
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَآءَ}} ({{tr:al-māʾa}}) is the definite direct object of the sending-down verb: the known life-giving medium is what reaches the earth. It sits at the hinge between humbled stillness and animated response. The root dispute can sharpen the sense of water as concrete substance, but the local noun remains the medium that activates the earth-life sequence, with 21:30 giving a concrete water-life parallel.

topics.headline: water hinge of revival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices water as the concrete hinge that turns humbled earth toward motion and life.
topics.reason: QAC makes the definite water noun the direct object of the causative descent verb.

topics.headline: substance pressure limited
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can keep substance pressure in view, while local grammar keeps the word as concrete water.
topics.reason: The disputed root-family pressure is lexical background and does not alter the local direct-object sense.

words.gloss_range: feminine perfect response verb: the earth itself stirs or vibrates after water descends
words.root_gloss_range: shaking, stirring, vibration, and visible motion; local Form VIII-like shape presents internalized earth animation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱهْتَزَّتْ}} ({{tr:ihtazzat}}) makes the earth the grammatical actor of the first response: after water descends, the once-still surface stirs. The shaking is a life-index before growth is named, and the Form VIII-like shape presents the motion as internalized animation. Its doubled sound and rare selection make the vibration audible, while the parallel with 22:5 confirms the earth-revival pattern.

topics.headline: earth begins to stir
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth is no longer only a patient; it becomes the actor of visible stirring.
topics.reason: QAC parses the verb as feminine perfect agreeing with the earth and functioning as the first result verb.

topics.headline: audible revival vibration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and recognizes the stirring as a marked resurrection-proof motion, especially beside the reprise in 22:5.
topics.reason: The row set supports both the 22:5 parallel and the rare sound-texture profile of the selected verb.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that keeps motion and swelling as paired but distinct earth responses
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the two earth-response verbs without collapsing them. The ayah lets motion and swelling accompany one another, so the first sign of animation remains distinct from the expansion that follows.

topics.headline: motion and swelling paired
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two coordinated stages of response instead of a single generic growth event.
topics.reason: The conjunction is prefixed to the second response verb and coordinates it with the first result verb.

words.gloss_range: second feminine perfect earth-response: swelling or rising expansion after stirring
words.root_gloss_range: lordship/nurturing root in the supplied alignment, but local verbal evidence selects swelling/increase with variant rising pressure
words.prose: {{ar:رَبَتْ}} ({{tr:rabat}}) continues the earth’s feminine subjecthood as the second response after stirring: the earth swells or rises. The paired verb completes the low-to-expanded arc from humbled stillness to animated growth before explicit life is named. Variant evidence can foreground rising separately, but it serves the local swelling/increase scene rather than replacing it with an unrelated root branch.

topics.headline: swelling completes response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earth-response complete as expansion after vibration, before the ayah names life explicitly.
topics.reason: QAC parses the verb as a feminine perfect second response verb of the earth after water descends.

topics.headline: swelling with rising color
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears swelling with possible rising articulation, while local grammar keeps the meaning within the earth-growth response.
topics.reason: The accepted variant evidence adds rising color, but the local paired response remains the earth’s swelling/increase after stirring.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the inferential conclusion after the visible proof
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) shifts the ayah from description into asserted inference. After the observer has seen stillness, water, motion, and swelling, the emphatic clause states what the sequence proves: the reviver of the earth is able to revive the dead.

topics.headline: assertion after proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that assertion follows staged observation, so the doctrine lands as inference rather than unsupported premise.
topics.reason: The particle opens the emphatic nominal clause that follows the earth-response result clause.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun identifying the agent by the reviving act just witnessed
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِىٓ}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) identifies the agent through the act that follows. Instead of naming the agent abstractly first, the relative construction points to the one who gave life to the earth, making the visible proof the route into divine identification.

topics.headline: identity through action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that agency is identified through the witnessed reviving act, not introduced as a bare title.
topics.reason: QAC parses the masculine singular relative pronoun as the subject of the emphatic clause with a relative clause following it.

words.gloss_range: causative perfect life-giving act with the earth as object, turning growth into explicit revival
words.root_gloss_range: life, living, vivification, and vitality; local Form IV selects caused enlivening of the earth
words.prose: {{ar:أَحْيَاهَا}} ({{tr:aḥyāhā}}) names the completed change as life-giving, not merely vegetation or growth. The object suffix keeps the same earth in view, and Form IV presents life as bestowed rather than self-arisen. That past act becomes the premise for the participial predicate that follows, so the one who enlivened the earth is declared the enlivener of the dead; 57:17 offers another earth-revival formulation.

topics.headline: growth named as life
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the analogy’s key upgrade: the earth’s response is named as bestowed life.
topics.reason: QAC parses the verb as a Form IV perfect with a 3FS object suffix referring to the earth.

topics.headline: life root bridges domains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same life root from earth revival toward the resurrection predicate, while the local verb remains the completed act on the earth.
topics.reason: The broader life-family evidence supports the earth-to-dead bridge, but local valence fixes the object as the earth.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lām prefixed to the predicate, strengthening the resurrection conclusion
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is not a governing preposition here; it is the emphatic prefix at the predicate threshold. Together with the preceding emphatic particle, it stacks assertion exactly where the argument moves from revived earth to reviver of the dead.

topics.headline: emphatic predicate threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears extra assertion concentrated at the move from observed earth revival to resurrection capacity.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as an emphatic lām prefixed to the predicate, not as a preposition governing a complement.

words.gloss_range: active-participle predicate: standing life-giving agency governing the dead as object-domain
words.root_gloss_range: life, reviving, and vivification; local participle turns the earth act into durable resurrection agency

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the earlier completed enlivening act echoed by the participial predicate

words.prose: {{ar:مُحْىِ}} ({{tr:muḥyī}}) converts the completed act of enlivening the earth into a standing predicate: the agent is life-giver of the dead. The active participle retains verbal force over its object-domain, so the claim is not abstract benevolence but durable reviving agency aimed at the dead. Its echo of {{ar:أَحْيَاهَا}} ({{tr:aḥyāhā}}) makes the analogy lexical as well as logical, and 75:40 gives a related resurrection-capacity question.

topics.headline: standing reviver identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one completed earth-revival act becomes a durable identity of life-giving agency.
topics.reason: QAC parses the word as a masculine singular active participle predicate with verbal force governing the dead.

topics.headline: life root reaches resurrection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the life root from the revived earth into a resurrection-capacity formula that also resonates with 75:40.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and echo rows support the life/death/power linkage while the local participle supplies the predicate.

words.gloss_range: definite collective dead as the explicit resurrection target of the life-giver predicate
words.root_gloss_range: death, deadness, lifelessness, and stillness; local definite collective keeps literal dead beings distinct from earth dormancy

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the completed earth-revival act that sets up the life/death opposition
the life-giver predicate governing the dead as object-domain

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَوْتَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:al-mawtā}}) names the target class only after the earth has been revived before the listener’s eyes. The definite collective moves beyond one corpse or one patch of land to the known class of dead beings, and it keeps resurrection literal rather than dissolving into vegetation metaphor. It completes the life/death opposition created by {{ar:أَحْيَاهَا}} ({{tr:aḥyāhā}}) and {{ar:مُحْىِ}} ({{tr:muḥyī}}), with 30:19 joining life-from-dead and earth revival in a related pattern.

topics.headline: dead as collective target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hard resurrection target is delayed until the visible earth analogue has been established.
topics.reason: QAC parses the word as a definite plural/collective complement governed in sense by the life-giver predicate.

topics.headline: literal death, not metaphor only
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the analogy turn on literal life/death reversal, while root range still allows the earth’s prior dormancy as analogy base.
topics.reason: The root can extend to stillness, but the definite collective in this predicate names dead beings as the resurrection target.

words.gloss_range: second emphatic clause with pronoun resuming the reviving agent for universal capacity
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahū}}) restarts the syntax for the final capacity assertion. The attached pronoun gathers the relative description of the earth-reviving agent into a compact referent, allowing the ayah to move from the specific resurrection inference to universal ability without fragmenting the agency chain.

topics.headline: from proof to universal seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same reviving agent is re-anchored before the ayah expands from resurrection proof to universal capacity.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an emphatic particle with a 3MS pronoun opening the final capacity clause.

words.gloss_range: scope preposition marking abstract authority over the domain of every thing
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) governs the total-scope phrase as the field over which capacity applies. In this construction it is abstract mastery, not physical position. Because the scope phrase comes before the final predicate, unlimited domain is heard before the attribute names the capacity.

topics.headline: scope before capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the domain of power opened exhaustively before the final attribute lands.
topics.reason: QAC parses the preposition as governing the totality phrase and marking the scope of the capacity predicate.

words.gloss_range: construct quantifier distributing capacity over every possible referent
words.root_gloss_range: totality, entirety, and exhaustive inclusion; local construct gives distributive universality

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the indefinite singular complement that completes the total-scope construct

words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) begins the exhaustive scope phrase. As a singular construct with {{ar:شَىْءٍۢ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}), it distributes capacity over each referable entity rather than offering vague greatness. That totalizing move prevents resurrection from being treated as an exception and also links the closure to the surah’s later totality language in 41:53 and 41:54; 2:20 provides a familiar capacity-formula parallel.

topics.headline: every item included
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claim distributes over every item, leaving resurrection no exceptional category outside capacity.
topics.reason: QAC parses the word as genitive first term of a construct with the following indefinite singular noun.

topics.headline: capacity formula specialized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a familiar total-capacity formula specialized after the worked earth-revival proof, with 41:54 and 2:20 sharpening the formulaic horizon.
topics.reason: The rows provide formulaic co-occurrence evidence and concrete inter-ayah parallels at 41:54 and 2:20.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular thing completing the total distributive domain before the final attribute
words.root_gloss_range: thing, entity, matter, object, or case; local singular indefinite maximizes unrestricted reference under the quantifier

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the construct quantifier governing the indefinite singular complement

words.prose: {{ar:شَىْءٍۢ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}) completes the total-scope phrase as an indefinite singular. Under {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}), it makes universality distributive over each possible thing rather than a bounded list. Its breadth can include earth, water, life, death, and resurrection under one capacity field, and 54:49 offers a related thing-and-measure horizon.

topics.headline: unrestricted thing-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no named category limits the final scope; each referable thing falls under the predicate.
topics.reason: QAC parses the word as an indefinite genitive complement of the totality construct.

topics.headline: domain completed before attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the universal field completed before the final capacity word answers it, with 41:53, 41:54, and 54:49 widening the resonance.
topics.reason: The rows support the formulaic thing-capacity pairing and the placement of the scope phrase before the final predicate.

words.gloss_range: final qualitative predicate of capacity over the already universalized domain
words.root_gloss_range: measuring, determining, apportioning, and effective ability; local adjective states stable ordered capacity
words.prose: {{ar:قَدِيرٌ}} ({{tr:qadīrun}}) is the final predicate: after the scope has been universalized, the last word names stable capacity. The root joins measure and effective ability, so the closure is ordered efficacy rather than raw force. Its qualitative form, formulaic setting, sound landing, and position at the ayah’s end make the earth scene and resurrection inference resolve in a universal attribute, while 2:106 gives another total-capacity formula and 41:38 provides the boundary contrast from denied weariness to asserted power.

topics.headline: final capacity attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on a stable attribute of capacity after the domain has already been made total.
topics.reason: QAC parses the adjective as the nominative predicate of the final emphatic clause after a preposed total-scope phrase.

topics.headline: ordered power as formulaic seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears total power as ordered effective capacity, while local syntax keeps the word as the final predicate rather than a full theory of measure.
topics.reason: The root range includes measure and determining, but the local adjective in the formula asserts capacity over every thing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence al-ard khashiatan, anzalna alayha al-ma, ihtazzat wa-rabat.
baseline_models.mechanism: A low, visibly dormant surface receives water, passes into motion and swelling, and manifests the life that had been unavailable to sight.

activation_trace.role: Earth as a fertile growing medium supplies the substrate whose capacity is initially hidden.
A low, dormant tract supplies the initial state of arrested visible activity.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the activating input to the dormant substrate.
Earth and vegetation stirring into life marks the first observable phase transition.
Increase and elevation supply the expanding second phase of reactivation.
Land made alive by rain names the completed transformation and its causal analogue.

changed_reading.before: A familiar observation that rain makes dry ground grow.
changed_reading.after: A staged activation trace in which apparent lifelessness is latent capacity made visible by a fitting input.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Min ayatihi, tarā, ahyaha, la-muhyi al-mawta.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse makes a seen terrestrial reversal function as evidence for an unseen human reversal: the same agent who crosses the life boundary in the land can cross it for the dead.

activation_trace.role: A manifest marker frames the land-cycle as evidence rather than scenery.
Direct and inward seeing makes the reader inspect the observable premise of the analogy.
Rain-life in the land supplies the demonstrated crossing from dormancy to vitality.
Loss of force and life names the boundary whose reversibility is at issue.
Effective capacity carries the observed act across to the promised reanimation of the dead.

changed_reading.before: A resurrection claim followed by a general assertion of divine power.
changed_reading.after: An empirical-to-eschatological argument: witnessed revival is the local demonstration of capacity to revive the dead.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Wa-rabat and innahu ala kulli shayin qadir.
baseline_models.mechanism: Growth reaches an increased state through proportioned provision; qadir therefore carries both effective capacity and the ability to bring each thing to an apt measure within an exhaustive scope.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and development construe swelling as governed growth rather than undirected expansion.
A thing reaching its bounded amount supplies the proportional aspect of the final predicate.
Deliberate estimation and fitting add ordered process to sheer ability.
Comprehensive inclusion prevents the measured operation from being confined to vegetation.
Every knowable entity supplies the unrestricted object-domain of the capacity.

changed_reading.after: The closing power claim includes exact fitting, nurture, and completion across every entity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The earth is khashiatan before it rises.
baseline_models.mechanism: Khushu joins a physical low, quiet surface to a posture of yielding; the subsequent motion shows that lowliness can be receptive readiness rather than exhausted finality.

activation_trace.role: Clinging low to the ground supplies the spatial stillness from which receptivity begins.
Yielding humility gives the earth's low posture a live relational valence.
Dormant low land keeps that relational reading materially anchored.
An inward stirring toward energy makes the response compatible with joy rather than mere agitation.
Rising after yielding reverses the assumption that humility and elevation are opposites.

changed_reading.before: Khushu is only a visual synonym for barren stillness.
changed_reading.after: The earth's lowliness is a receptive posture whose answer to descent is energetic elevation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same descent root delivers revelation at the surah's opening and close and water in the focus; revelation is detailed and healing, but only a receptive addressee responds, as humble earth responds to water.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent and delivery anchors the shared transport mechanism in the focus.
Delivered water supplies the physical medium that activates a receptive recipient.
Yielding receptivity anchors the transfer from land-response to hearer-response.
The delivered descent of revelation establishes the first explicit counterpart to delivered water.
Tender mercy qualifies the descending message as life-oriented provision.
Articulation into distinct meanings makes revelation an input that can penetrate and reorganize understanding.
A second revelation-descent closes the lexical frame around the focus water-descent.
Healing and restored soundness specify the life-effect of revelation on a responsive hearer.
Weight in the ear supplies the blocked-reception counterpart to irrigable earth.
Inner blindness names the failure of a sign to activate perception.

structural_cues: The surah opens and later returns to tanzil, while the focus uses anzalna for water.
41:44 opposes healing guidance to blocked hearing and inward blindness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: shared descent language, healing, and blocked reception; inference: water-to-earth supplies a model for revelation-to-hearer; live alternative: the shared root may coordinate divine gifts without making a sustained metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The water-cycle proves bodily resurrection but remains separate from the surah's discourse about revelation.
changed_reading.after: The cycle also models revelatory activation: descent gives life where humility permits reception, while covered faculties remain inert.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earth belongs to a creation that comes willingly and is framed by prostration and praise, whereas arrogant humans claim superior strength; its khushu is therefore obedient responsiveness, and its rising displays commanded life rather than self-exaltation.

activation_trace.role: Humble yielding anchors the earth's physical posture in a relation of obedience.
Its subsequent elevation becomes the result of reception rather than a boast of autonomous height.
The terrestrial counterpart to heaven identifies the same earth as an addressed creature.
Willing compliance supplies the creation-wide disposition later embodied by the humble land.
Self-magnification supplies the human counter-posture enacted upon the earth.
Concentrated strength supplies the rival human claim displaced by the focus claim of total capacity.
Lowering in prostration gives ritual precision to the focus earth's humble posture.
Arrogance immediately before the focus sharpens the contrast between refusal and terrestrial receptivity.
Continuous worship places the focus sign inside an active liturgy of creation.

structural_cues: 41:11 personifies heaven and earth as willingly responsive.
41:37-39 forms a contiguous sequence of signs, prostration, tireless praise, arrogance, and humble earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: willing creation, prostration, praise, and human arrogance surround the focus; inference: the earth's khushu participates in cosmic obedience; live alternative: khashiatan may remain only a physical description of dry land.

changed_reading.before: The land is low because it is depleted.
changed_reading.after: The land is low yet responsive, enacting the obedience that arrogant humans resist; its God-given rising is the vindication of receptivity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier creation sequence makes, stabilizes, blesses, provisions, measures, completes, and guards; the focus revival is another phase of that ordered provisioning, so final capacity is exercised through exact fit and sequence.

activation_trace.role: Measured planning anchors the closing capacity claim in ordered execution.
Nurtured development supplies the focus outcome of provision correctly applied.
Origination of the earth establishes the same agent and substrate as the focus revival.
The earth as the lower created domain carries identity across creation and reanimation.
Stable, growing good supplies the intended persistence of terrestrial provision.
Earlier measuring of provisions makes the focus qadir echo an enacted design process.
Life-sustaining nourishment identifies what the earth is configured to mediate.
Completed and effective making supplies the endpoint of measured creation.
Explicit estimation names the cosmic scale of the same measured agency.
Guarding what was ordered adds preservation to origination and growth.

structural_cues: 41:9-12 is a phased earth-and-heaven construction sequence.
Q-d-r occurs in the provisioning sequence, its summation, and the focus conclusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: creation, measured sustenance, completion, protection, and focus growth share one sequence of agency; inference: resurrection is continuous with ordered provisioning; live alternative: qadir may primarily close the verse with unrestricted ability.

changed_reading.before: Revival interrupts nature as a bare miracle.
changed_reading.after: Revival completes a recurrent economy of making, measuring, feeding, preserving, and returning life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bodies testify, every thing can be made articulate, and signs are shown across horizons and selves until truth becomes clear; the moving earth therefore acts not only as an analogy but as nonverbal testimony to return.

activation_trace.role: A visible marker makes the revived land capable of evidentiary force.
Seeing recruits the observer who receives the land's evidence.
Present witnessing supplies the juridical mode into which material signs can enter.
The body's own covering becomes a witness, establishing that material surfaces can disclose hidden histories.
An articulate indication extends speech beyond ordinary human utterance.
The unrestricted entity class allows earth to belong to the field made evidentially articulate.
Return to a prior state links material testimony directly to the focus promise of revived dead.
Caused showing turns signs into an unfolding disclosure rather than a static inventory.
Manifest signs explicitly reconnect the finale to the focus land-sign.
Far horizons expand the scale of testimony to the external world.
The self as the entity itself supplies the inward scale complementary to the land.
Emergence into clarity names the cumulative effect of outward and inward evidence.

structural_cues: 41:20-21 turns bodily materials into witnesses and pairs first creation with return.
41:53 reprises showing and signs across outer and inner domains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: material bodies testify and horizon/self signs become clear; inference: the focus earth's motion is a nonverbal witness to return; live alternative: body testimony and natural signs may remain distinct evidentiary scenes.

changed_reading.before: The land is an object observed by a human witness.
changed_reading.after: The land itself performs testimony through motion and growth, while the viewer becomes recipient of that material witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus swelling can be read as gestational latency: water enters a fertile body, concealed increase becomes visible movement, and life emerges; 41:47 then aligns fruit leaving sheaths with hidden pregnancy and delivery under encompassing knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Fertile earth supplies the receptive body in which concealed growth can occur.
A pregnancy becoming outwardly visible supplies a branch-level bridge from seeing to swelling.
Generative fluid entering a womb supplies the most form-distant input image for gestational activation.
Increase and swelling supply the visible phase of concealed development.
Knowledge as disclosure holds both cosmic timing and hidden biological processes in one frame.
Coming out from concealment supplies the transition from latent life to manifest issue.
Mature fruit supplies the botanical issue of hidden terrestrial growth.
A plant's enclosing sheath supplies the container from which its issue emerges.
Hidden pregnancy and fruit explicitly join biological and botanical carrying.
The female bearer supplies the animate counterpart to fertile earth.
Delivery of a carried life supplies the endpoint corresponding to emergence from the land.

structural_cues: 41:47 coordinates fruit emergence, enclosing sheaths, pregnancy, and delivery in one sentence.
The focus progresses from receptive body through swelling to life before naming resurrection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: fertile earth, swelling, fruit-sheaths, hidden pregnancy, and delivery; inference: resurrection is figured as gestation and emergence; live alternative: the two scenes may simply enumerate separate objects of divine knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection resembles plants restarting after rain.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection also resembles concealed life carried to term and brought out: emergence and birth, not only regrowth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated stimulus-response clauses contrast earth and human: water makes humble earth move and grow, while affliction makes the human despair and mercy or favor produces possession-talk and withdrawal; vitality becomes apt responsiveness, not mere reaction.

activation_trace.role: Yielding receptivity supplies the earth's initial disposition toward its incoming gift.
Stirring into energy supplies an affirmative response rather than panic or refusal.
Nurtured growth makes the earth's response productive.
An impact that leaves an effect supplies the adverse stimulus in the human response cycle.
Hope cut off supplies the first maladaptive endpoint.
A second image of severed hope intensifies the collapse under adverse contact.
Tender mercy supplies the beneficial stimulus that the human misattributes as private possession.
A favorable state supplies another life-giving input whose reception is tested.
Turning one's side away supplies the refusal that contrasts with the earth's receptive posture.
Drawing the flank away spatializes the human's self-isolating response to favor.

structural_cues: 41:39 and 41:49-51 repeatedly use conditional or idha stimulus-result sequencing.
The earth's received good yields growth; the human's received good yields appropriation or withdrawal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: parallel stimulus-response syntax and opposed outcomes; inference: the earth becomes an ethical comparator for human receptivity; live alternative: the later human portrait may concern ingratitude without deliberately personifying the focus land.

changed_reading.after: Life also means fitting response to what descends or touches: humble earth is more alive in reception than the reactive, self-enclosed human.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant r-w-y mapping for the focus sight-root, so it is form-distant and must not be presented as the lexical meaning of tara; it remains anchored to tara, water, and signs, and prose should mark it only as an exploratory branch resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Tarā stands directly before the dry-earth and water sequence.

activation_trace.role: Satiation after thirst lets the commanded seeing resonate as perception itself being refreshed.
Carrying and bringing water lets sight function experimentally as the carrier of the life-giving sign.
Actual water delivery keeps the perceptual hydration resonance attached to the verse's material process.
The manifest sign supplies what perception receives and by which it is renewed.
The later caused showing of signs extends the exploratory image of perception relieved of thirst.

changed_reading.before: Seeing is a neutral channel that reports the revived land.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sign irrigates perception itself: the viewer is another dry recipient brought to cognitive life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain structural analogy triggered by the liquid-discharge branch of d-f-a in 41:34, not a claim that social conduct is lexically rain; it remains anchored to the focus input-and-transformation sequence, and downstream prose should label it as a heuristic resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Water arrives upon a depleted field and converts its state into life and increase.

activation_trace.role: A beneficial input delivered onto a recipient anchors the social analogy in the focus process.
Life as benefit allows revived relation to remain tied to the focus life-language.
Removing harm by a counteraction supplies the social intervention.
A single discharge of rain or liquid gives that counteraction an irrigation-like branch image.
Affectionate alliance supplies the transformed relational state.
Intimate nearness specifies how far the formerly hostile field has been renewed.

changed_reading.before: The focus transformation belongs only to soil and future bodies.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a well-chosen beneficial counter-input can irrigate a deadened social relation until hostility becomes intimacy.

strongest_changes: The shared descent root turns rain-revival into a model of revelation activating receptive hearers.
Creation's willing obedience and the worship sequence recast the low earth as responsive humility opposed to human arrogance.
The early measured-provisioning sequence makes resurrection continuous with ordered creation rather than an isolated display of force.
Fruit, sheath, pregnancy, and delivery make emergence or birth a second live model of resurrection.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet converted a compact agronomic proof into several coexisting mechanisms: revelatory reception, cosmic obedience, measured provision, material testimony, gestational emergence, and an ethical test of responsiveness.
remaining_uncertainties: The revelatory-irrigation reading may be deliberate lexical architecture or only a productive recurrence of descent language.
The gestational model is strongly sequenced by 41:47 but depends partly on form-distant focus branches.
Hydrated perception and social irrigation should remain explicitly exploratory rather than become lexical claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Low depletion becomes visible vitality through a staged material mechanism.** **خ ش ع B002** gives low desolate ground, **ن ز ل B002** brings water down, **م و ه B001/B003** supplies water and pouring, **ه ز ز B002** earth stirring with life, **ر ب و B001** increase and rising, and **ح ي ي B002** earth revived by growth. The ayah itself supplies the causal order. “Humbled” thus retains a physical reading of depletion that makes revival inspectable.
2. **An exploratory reproductive analogue.** **م و ه B004** includes male fluid placed in the womb, **ر ب و B005** nurture and growth, and **ح ي ي B003** animate life. The sequence of fluid, stirring, swelling, and life activates gestational imagery. I infer an analogy rather than identity: the land functions like a receptive generative body. This reading remains anchored but secondary because no womb term occurs in the fixed ayah.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:47 strongly sharpens the reproductive reading through fruit emerging from sheaths, female pregnancy, and laying down at birth. 41:53 then places signs in horizons and selves, explicitly licensing comparison between external land and embodied generation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Revival is a visible phase transition.** Lexically, `خ ش ع B002` is low, desolate, dormant dry ground, `ن ز ل B002` includes sending down water, `ه ز ز B002` is earth and plants stirring with life, `ر ب و B001` increase and rising, and `ح ي ي B002` earth brought alive by rain and growth. Structurally, the ayah presents an ordered sequence—visible low stillness, water descent, motion, swelling, life—then maps it to enlivening the dead. I assign each root a process stage; the abductive arrow is that the observed transition supplies a material model for an otherwise unseen transition. The ayah reads resurrection as a demonstrated transformation grammar rather than an unsupported analogy.

2. **Capacity is shown through process, not bare assertion.** `ق د ر B003` is capacity reaching effective control. It closes after the full causal sequence and the generalization to the dead. I assign `قدير` the role of naming the control evidenced by coordinating all stages. The inference is that effective power is legible in repeatable transitions. The closing attribute therefore reads as a conclusion from the sign as well as a declaration.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:44 supplied the most surprising extension: guidance and healing can act on a blocked receiver as water acts on dormant ground. The regeneration model therefore reaches both resurrection and repaired reception.

baseline.text: O'nun ayetlerinden biri de şudur: Yeri boynu bükük görürsün; üzerine suyu indirdiğimizde titreşir ve kabarır. Şüphesiz onu dirilten, ölüleri de mutlaka diriltir. Şüphesiz O, her şeye gücü yetendir.

findings.text: Alçalmış kuru toprağın suyla titreşip kabarması, dirilişi durgunluktan harekete ve büyümeye geçen gözlenebilir bir madde dönüşümü olarak gösterir.
Sıvı, titreşme, şişme ve canlılık dizisi, toprağı üretici bir beden gibi okuyan gebelik benzetisini çağrıştırır.
Her şeye yeten güç, soyut bir iddiadan çok, dönüşümün bütün aşamalarını etkili biçimde yöneten denetim olarak görünür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Irrigated Ground Rises From Dormancy
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Low, dormant soil receives water, shakes, swells, and becomes living growth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fertile and plant-bearing earth `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`; low and dormant ground `quranic:root_000412:B002/m01`; rain or water brought down `quranic:root_001492:B002/m02`; water supplied by pouring or irrigation `quranic:root_001458:B003/m01`; earth and vegetation shaking into life `quranic:root_001588:B002/m01`; swelling and increase `quranic:root_000537:B001/m01`; life of earth through rain and plants `quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`; dead uncultivated land `quranic:root_001454:B003/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Water does not merely cover the soil; it triggers motion, swelling, and renewed growth. The dead-land sense makes resurrection a change of state in a material substrate.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi oyalanma, durup bekleme, bir isin imkanini bekleme ve kalinan yer anlamlarini birlikte verir. Verilen dal cercevesi bu bekleme ve kalma cekirdegini sadik bicimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal hedefe yonelme, isaret adi veya soru edati degil; bekleme ve kalma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bare kapsam, anlami kokten gelen bekleme ve kalma cekirdegiyle sinirlar; baska edat veya ad kullanimlari buraya alinmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde veya bir isin basinda oyalanarak durmak, beklemek ya da kalinacak yer olarak tutulmak.

facets.statement: Kisi veya sey hareketi erteleyip durur, oyalanir ya da bekler.
Bir isin gerceklesme imkanini bekleme anlami da ayni durup bekleme cekirdegine baglidir.
Kalinan veya beklenilen yer icin konaklama ve tutulma yeri anlaminda adlasmis kullanim vardir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin temelini durma, oyalanma ve bekleme olarak verir; ayrica bir isin imkanini bekleme ve kalinacak yer kullanimi ayni anlam alaninda yer alir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yakin veya uzak muhataba seslenme icin kullanilan nida birimlerini verir ve uzatilmis bicimi de ekler. Dal cercevesi bunu soru veya aciklama islevlerinden ayri olarak dogru sinirlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu birimi yemin veya ant oncesinde gelen, evet ya da bilakis onay degeri tasiyan acilis sozu olarak verir. Dal cercevesi bunu soru, aciklama ve zamir islevlerinden ayirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak ekseni, bir konu hakkında zihinsel bir yargı veya görüş oluşturmaktır. Bilme ya da sanma değeri belirli tümce yapılarında, danışma ise başka birinin görüşünü istemede ortaya çıkar; bunlar yalın çekirdeğin eş düzeyli anlamları sayılmamalıdır.
